column1: # The judgement of audit-hachi-lang-sh-b (2026-11-03, written for this pack, GPL-3.0-or-later): words whose
# first result is their own headword (an empty trace) while no lemma row of that entry has the sense of the
# word's dominant use; the right lemma comes later, through a rule or a reference. Read from the entries of
# the 700 most frequent such words of FrequencyWords hr_50k and the most frequent sr_50k ones the hr list
# lacks, and six words audit-hachi-lang-sh-c added (si, ovoga, ovoj, tiče, tih, stari). Column 3 names the
# lists that count the word strictly: radi, može, stara, luda, tih and stari have a second
# common use, and video is mostly the noun in Croatian. measure.py ownentry reads it.
